description: Retrieval eval ground truth for BRAIN2-SEMANTIC. Each pair maps a natural-language query (deliberately paraphrase-heavy, low keyword overlap where possible) to the exact title of the note that answers it in the QUOX DEVELOPMENT org corpus. Expected notes are resolved to noteIds at run time by exact title match, so this file survives reindexes. Queries run AS the owning user (user_id) because much of the corpus (e.g. Agent Memory) is user-scope: an anonymous caller correctly cannot see it, which is RBAC, not retrieval quality.
